hero.name: Hatem Mehana
hero.description: I build gameplay systems with Unity and C#, design levels, and help teams turn ideas into playable experiences.

about.description: I develop games using Unity and C#, with a focus on gameplay programming, level design, lighting, and environment creation. I founded RTG Studio and collaborate on game production. My work includes Azooma Escape on Steam and Implant Mission: The Lost Tree, ranked #1 Overall in the Game Zanga (Special Edition) public voting results in 2024.

skills.title: Gameplay Programming
points: Developing gameplay systems using C# and Unity.
Building AI systems to create dynamic interaction with the environment.
Designing UI systems compatible with different platforms
Using Photon and Unity Netcode to support multiplayer gaming over the network.

skills.title: Level Design
points: Designing complete game environments while considering performance and aesthetics.
Using blockouts to test gameplay mechanics before finalizing the design.
Optimizing performance using LOD, Occlusion Culling, Sprite Grass, Light Baking, and more
Adding lighting and fog effects to create immersive atmospheres.

skills.title: Team Leadership
points: Planning project timelines to ensure on-time delivery.
Organizing team tasks and distributing roles to ensure efficient workflow.
Using project management tools like Jira, Notion, Milanote to organize ideas and timelines.
Managing versions using Git, GitHub, GitLab to track modifications.
Maintaining continuous communication with the team and providing real-time updates.
